desc:
Turn colorful beads into pixel art, one step at a time! ✨

🎁 Open packs to collect patterns and discover rare designs.
👟 Walk across the board to place your beads.
✨ Finish your pattern, then grab the iron and fuse the beads together.
🪙 Display your creations, collect coins, and open more packs.
🏡 Visit other studios and show off your favorite pieces.

💡 Tips
• Beads only go on spaces that match your selected color.
• Step onto a display stand to collect its coins.

👍 LIKE & FAVORITE to support, it helps the game grow!
      What will you make next?
